description: This file defines models, query parameters, and data fetching logic for Congress Bills in a legislative data project. It includes classes for query parameters, data representation, and a fetcher for retrieving bills from the Congress API, with data transformation and validation.

classes.name: CongressBillsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for filtering Congress Bills, including congress number, bill type, date range, limit, offset, and sorting.

classes.name: CongressBillsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for a Congress Bill, including metadata such as update date, latest action, URL, and bill details.

classes.name: CongressBillsFetcher
classes.description: Handles data fetching from the Congress API, including transforming query parameters, extracting data asynchronously, and transforming raw data into model instances.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a CongressBillsQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and extracts bill data from the Congress API based on query parameters and credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of CongressBillsData model instances, sorting and extracting latest action info.
